items.author: urfaselol
items.body_excerpt: Margin calls can lead to forced liquidations, with forced sellers driving the stock price even lower. The only way to get out of it is for the value of the collateral to increase (think: the stock price going up) or for the borrower to put up additional equity and/or cash.…
